text:
ana: Drafting a tiny 3-email microflow for trial signups who attended the benchmark webinar. Need subject lines, send windows, and segment rules. Quick opinions?

morgan: Love the idea. My vote: send #1 within 2hrs. Subject A/B: 'Thanks for joining — benchmark highlights' vs 'Top findings + a quick trial invite' :thumbsup:

kai: Day 2 for email #2 with 1–2 short clips + invite to a live Q&A (or on‑demand clip). Segment by webinar attendance + whether they started trial.

sam: For people who didn't start trial, keep the CTA single and very clear: 'Try it in 5 mins' + 1 line of social proof. For starters, share a short onboarding checklist.

priya: We'll need UTM params and tracking keys. Proposed tags: webinar_attended=true/false, trial_started=true/false. Also include an open-only variant for one subject test.

devon: Ops note: respect global send caps — stagger sends so we don't hit limits. Also cap resend frequency to 72h per user.

marketing-bot: Campaign skeleton 'trial-webinar-microflow' created in scheduler (draft). Waiting on copy + subject picks.

ana: (typo) -- corrected above

ana: jk — assembling copy now. Can someone own subject-line A/Bs? @morgan?

morgan: I got it. Will drop two polished subject lines and preview text by 11:30 PT. Also can we run a quick deliverability check for APAC sends?

kai: +1 for APAC check. Recommended local send window: 9:00–11:00 local. Fallback 16:00 if system restrictions.

sam: Quick segment CSV I'm planning to attach to the campaign:
```
email,webinar_attended,trial_started
jane@example.com,true,false
john@example.com,true,true
```

ana: Perfect — once Morgan posts the subject lines I'll push to #marketing-docs for review and schedule the staged sends. Thanks all!
